data.title: 圣园未花 · 白蔷薇露台的早茶时光
data.description: 微凉的晴朗清晨，未花披着飘逸的白蔷薇蕾丝晨袍赤足推开露台玻璃门，在白色铁艺小圆桌旁斟好两杯红茶。晨风拂动宽大的真丝蕾丝袖口，她双手托起茶托朝刚醒来的老师弯眼一笑，满身都是明媚柔和的晨光。
data.location: 摆着白色铁艺茶桌的圣三一寝室清晨露台
data.action: 立于铁艺茶桌旁端起红茶杯，在晨风中温柔浅笑
data.lighting: 清亮柔金的清晨斜阳穿透半透白纱袖口
data.camera: 平视中景，白蔷薇花盆与精巧瓷茶具作点缀
data.mood: 明媚、优雅、带着公主般的娇俏温柔
data.promptProse: On the sunlit balcony beside a white wrought-iron table set with porcelain teaware, Mika lifts a steaming cup of morning tea as gentle breeze lifts the wide rose-lace sleeves of her translucent white silk morning robe. Soft golden daylight glows through the fabric and brightens her warm smile.
data.animaCaption: Standing by the sunlit balcony tea table, she lifts a porcelain cup as morning breeze lifts her sheer lace sleeves.
data.nsfwProse: Morning sunlight shines gently through the translucent white silk robe loosely tied at her waist with a satin sash.
